rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for both the soybean plant or crop and its edible seeds.

example.english: People usually make tofu pudding from soybean.
example.jyutping: dau6 fu6 faa1 tung1 soeng4 jung6 wong4 dau2 zing2

rows.note: A speaker picks 大豆 mainly in formal, agricultural, or biological contexts rather than everyday food talk.

example.english: The soybean is an important oil crop.
example.traditional: 大豆係一種重要嘅油料作物。
example.jyutping: daai6 dau2 hai6 jat1 zung2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jau4 liu6 zok3 mat6
